```{r}

# INTERACTIVE HEALTH EQUALITY VS UNDER-5 MORTALITY
# V-Dem and World Bank Data
# WITH ADJUSTABLE Y-AXIS RANGE

# PART 1: Load packages

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(shiny)


# PART 2: Find and import both datasets

find_csv <- function(filename) {

  files <- list.files(
    path = ".",
    pattern = paste0("^", filename, "$"),
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(files) == 0) {
    files <- list.files(
      path = "~",
      pattern = paste0("^", filename, "$"),
      recursive = TRUE,
      full.names = TRUE
    )
  }

  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("Cannot find", filename))
  }

  files[1]
}

vdem_data <- read_csv(
  find_csv("vdem.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

mortality_data <- read_csv(
  find_csv("under5_mort.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# PART 3: Combine and clean datasets

graph_data <- vdem_data %>%
  select(iso3c, year, health_equality) %>%
  inner_join(
    mortality_data %>%
      select(
        iso3c,
        year,
        country,
        region,
        under5_mort
      ),
    by = c("iso3c", "year")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(health_equality),
    !is.na(under5_mort),
    !is.na(country),
    !is.na(region),
    !is.na(year)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year)
  )

# Check data

head(graph_data)

print(
  paste(
    "Total countries:",
    n_distinct(graph_data$iso3c)
  )
)


# PART 4: Set default values

default_year <- if (
  2022 %in% graph_data$year
) {
  2022
} else {
  max(graph_data$year)
}

# Maximum Y-axis value based on actual data

max_mortality <- max(
  150,
  ceiling(max(graph_data$under5_mort, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
)

default_y_max <- min(150, max_mortality)


# PART 5: Create Shiny interface

ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel(
    "Health Equality and Under-Five Mortality"
  ),

  p(
    "Explore whether countries with greater equality
     in healthcare access have lower under-five
     mortality rates."
  ),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(

      # YEAR SLIDER

      sliderInput(
        "year",
        "Select Year:",
        min = min(graph_data$year),
        max = max(graph_data$year),
        value = default_year,
        step = 1,
        sep = ""
      ),

      # REGION FILTER

      selectInput(
        "region",
        "Select Region:",
        choices = c(
          "All Regions",
          sort(unique(graph_data$region))
        )
      ),

      # NEW: ADJUSTABLE Y-AXIS RANGE

      sliderInput(
        "y_range",
        "Under-Five Mortality Y-Axis Range:",
        min = 0,
        max = max_mortality,
        value = c(0, default_y_max),
        step = 5
      ),

      # RESET BUTTON

      actionButton(
        "reset",
        "Reset Filters"
      ),

      hr(),

      p("Health equality data: V-Dem"),

      p("Under-five mortality data: World Bank"),

      p(
        "Mortality is measured as deaths before age 5
         per 1,000 live births."
      )
    ),

    mainPanel(

      plotlyOutput(
        "health_boxplot",
        height = "550px"
      ),

      h4("Summary Statistics"),

      tableOutput("summary_table"),

      textOutput("country_count"),

      textOutput("correlation_text")
    )
  )
)


# PART 6: Create Shiny server

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Filter by year and region

  filtered_data <- reactive({

    df <- graph_data %>%
      filter(year == input$year)

    if (input$region != "All Regions") {

      df <- df %>%
        filter(region == input$region)

    }

    # Divide countries into 3 health equality groups

    if (nrow(df) >= 3) {

      df <- df %>%
        mutate(
          Health_Group = ntile(
            health_equality, 3
          ),

          Health_Group = factor(
            Health_Group,
            levels = c(1, 2, 3),
            labels = c(
              "Lower Equality",
              "Middle Equality",
              "Higher Equality"
            )
          )
        )
    }

    df
  })


  # PART 7: Interactive Plotly boxplot

  output$health_boxplot <- renderPlotly({

    df <- filtered_data()

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(df) >= 6,
        "Not enough country data for this selection."
      )
    )

    # Country hover information

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        Hover = paste0(
          "Country: ", country,
          "<br>Year: ", year,
          "<br>Region: ", region,
          "<br>Health Equality: ",
          round(health_equality, 2),
          "<br>Under-5 Mortality: ",
          round(under5_mort, 2),
          " per 1,000 live births",
          "<br>Health Data: V-Dem",
          "<br>Mortality Data: World Bank"
        )
      )

    # Create boxplot

    p <- ggplot(
      df,
      aes(
        x = Health_Group,
        y = under5_mort,
        fill = Health_Group
      )
    ) +

      geom_boxplot(
        alpha = 0.65,
        outlier.shape = NA
      ) +

      geom_point(
        aes(text = Hover),
        position = position_jitter(
          width = 0.15,
          height = 0
        ),
        alpha = 0.65,
        size = 2
      ) +

      labs(
        title = paste(
          "Health Equality vs Under-Five Mortality:",
          input$year
        ),

        subtitle =
          "Comparison of countries grouped by health equality",

        x = "Health Equality Group",

        y = "Under-Five Deaths per 1,000 Live Births",

        caption = "Sources: V-Dem and World Bank"
      ) +

      theme_minimal() +

      theme(
        legend.position = "none",

        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold"
        ),

        axis.text.x = element_text(
          size = 10
        )
      )

    # Convert to Plotly and apply Y-axis slider

    ggplotly(
      p,
      tooltip = "text"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        yaxis = list(
          range = input$y_range,
          autorange = FALSE,
          title = "Under-Five Deaths per 1,000 Live Births"
        ),
        margin = list(
          t = 90
        )
      )
  })


  # PART 8: Summary statistics

  output$summary_table <- renderTable({

    df <- filtered_data()

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(df) >= 3,
        "Not enough data."
      )
    )

    df %>%
      group_by(Health_Group) %>%
      summarise(
        Countries = n_distinct(iso3c),

        Mean_Mortality = round(
          mean(under5_mort), 2
        ),

        Median_Mortality = round(
          median(under5_mort), 2
        ),

        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })


  # PART 9: Country count

  output$country_count <- renderText({

    paste(
      "Countries displayed:",
      n_distinct(filtered_data()$iso3c)
    )
  })


  # PART 10: Pearson correlation

  output$correlation_text <- renderText({

    df <- filtered_data()

    if (
      nrow(df) < 3 ||
      sd(df$health_equality) == 0 ||
      sd(df$under5_mort) == 0
    ) {
      return("Correlation unavailable.")
    }

    correlation <- cor(
      df$health_equality,
      df$under5_mort,
      use = "complete.obs"
    )

    paste(
      "Pearson correlation:",
      round(correlation, 3)
    )
  })


  # PART 11: Reset all filters

  observeEvent(input$reset, {

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "year",
      value = default_year
    )

    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "region",
      selected = "All Regions"
    )

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "y_range",
      value = c(0, default_y_max)
    )
  })

}


# PART 12: Run the app

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
